meta.name: deploy-to-vercel
meta.description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键将应用部署到 Vercel 并获取链接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将应用快速部署到 Vercel 并获取预览链接
copy.tagline_en: Deploy your app to Vercel and get a live link with one command
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy apps to Vercel and need instant preview URLs

howto.what: 当你要求部署网站或应用时,Claude 会先检查项目状态,再选择合适方式把它发布到 Vercel,默认生成预览版(除非你明确要求正式版),最后把访问链接发给你。
howto.when: 当你提出部署请求,如“部署我的应用”、“部署并给我链接”、“推送上线”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel,给我链接
say.note: 默认生成预览版,返回预览链接。

say.text: 给我创建一个预览部署
say.note: 生成预览链接供你查看。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到生产环境,发布正式版
say.note: 只有明确要求正式版,才会部署到生产。

howto.what_en: When you ask to deploy a website or app, Claude first checks the project state, then picks a suitable method to publish it to Vercel. It deploys as a preview by default (unless you explicitly ask for production) and returns the URL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests a deployment, e.g. "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", etc.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel and give me the link.
say_en.note: It deploys as a preview and returns the URL.

say_en.text: Create a preview deployment for me.
say_en.note: Generates a preview URL for you to view.

say_en.text: Deploy this to production as the live version.
say_en.note: Only explicit production requests get a production deploy.
